scale_note: Per-leg LOAD is 0-100 = hand-set pressure reading, same scale as the institutional dials: 0=slack, 100=at capacity. Every dial states its derivation in 'derive'. Register load counts are derived, not hand-set. The threshold row is the model's own output, not a score.

threshold.basis: Three of four legs fired (M, G, E). The fourth, T, is ABSENT at 82 load — not straining-into-fired. Since 2026-11-04 the T state has a stated moment: it fires on the first dated act satisfying D1-D4 of the leg 4 docking test, and holds only if a second dock lands within 90 days. No such act is on record. Legs fired is a count of fired/absent states, never of load. The claim this makes is falsifiable: if the rupture arrives by vanguard replacement while T read absent, the model is wrong and the register will say so.
threshold.note: MGET names which engine is driving, never the outcome. Load (0-100) and leg state (fired/absent) are different fields on purpose: a leg can carry heavy pressure and still be absent, which is exactly leg 4's position now.

legs.name: Material
legs.question: Can the country still physically afford its own continuity?
legs.plain: Energy, food, money, supply chains — the physical throughput the system runs on. High means the base is rationed and every political fight is now a fight over scarcity.
legs.derive: Hand-set. Anchors: Hormuz constrained (not closed), the oil price shock feeding consumer cost, SPR drawdown, grain and fertiliser supply stress.
legs.why: The leg is fired on price and availability, not on shortage. Nothing has run out. The tell is that cost is now the transmission belt: it arrives in household budgets before it arrives in any statistic, which is why it moves politics faster than it moves the model.

legs.name: Governance
legs.question: Can the institutions still produce decisions anyone accepts?
legs.plain: Courts, Congress, election offices, agencies, the civil service, the military. High means they are still issuing orders, and fewer people are obeying them.
legs.derive: Derived: the mean of the eight institutional dials in the Institutional Stress panel below (78.4, rounded). Moves only when they move, so the two panels cannot disagree.
legs.why: Five of eight dials sit in Critical. The courts still enjoin; the same docket is now aimed at election administration itself. Congress lost its own session day to avoid a floor vote. Nothing has stopped working. Everything is working against itself.

legs.name: Enclosure
legs.question: Who ends up owning the substrate everybody now depends on?
legs.plain: Surveillance systems, data, and the AI machinery. High means the dependency is being fenced into private hands faster than any rule can be written about it.
legs.derive: Hand-set. Anchors: ALPR and fusion-grid consolidation, press-access enclosure, scaffold-ownership as the live political fight.
legs.why: The lowest of the three fired legs, and the one that will outlast the others. Every other leg reverts when a government changes. This one reverts when a contract changes, which is rarer and slower.

legs.name: Turning
legs.question: Is the elite conflict still internal, or has something formed that could replace it?
legs.plain: Whether the fight is inside the old order between its own factions, or whether a new alignment has formed that could actually stand something up. High means the replacement exists. This is the leg that decides whether the period ends in repair or replacement.
legs.derive: Hand-set. Anchors: leg 4 reads drifting in the 2026-11-04 reading — strain is high, alignment is not formed.
legs.why: Highest load, absent state — the pair that matters, and now the pair with a stated boundary. Pressure toward realignment is heavy: 39 of 88 cards are filed here, the vanguard split-or-fusion card is live at 35%, post-defeat routing is unresolved, and the succession question is a day old. But no dated act satisfies D1-D4: no refusal has held, no organised body has endorsed a replacement authority, no veto institution has removed capacity, no transfer has completed. Backtest batch 1 (2026-11-04) re-coded 25 corpus cases against these tests: nine adjectives collapsed to three states, six verdicts that used a non-absent word re-coded to ABSENT for want of a dated act, and 0 of 7 null years and false-positive traps fired. The boundary case is 1890-1914: leg 4 ABSENT and the order ruptured anyway, by external capture rather than vanguard replacement. So absent means the rupture will not come from the vanguard — it says nothing about the external channel, which on this desk is the Iran track and the oil constraint.
legs.definition: Operational test, from /space/protocol/leg4-docking-test.json. Leg 4 FIRES on the first dated act satisfying ANY of four docking tests. D1 refusal that sticks: an actor whose compliance is required declines a lawful executive order and is not made to comply within 30 days; removal or reversal inside 30 days does NOT fire (MacArthur 1951, Mattis 2018 — both rejected on this clause). D2 formal endorsement of a replacement authority by an organised vanguard body — petition, association vote, caucus decision; individual sympathies and press commentary never count. D3 a veto institution removing executive capacity rather than delaying it; remand and rulings the executive rebuilds around do not fire. D4 a transfer act that COMPLETES — an appointment, dissolution or emergency clause installing an actor the constitutional order would not produce; attempts do not fire (court-packing 1937). PERSISTENCE: the leg holds fired only if a second dock occurs within 90 days; a single unrepeated dock is a tremor, logged fired-once, and reverts. This replaced the 2026-11 count test (3+ months, 5+ named defections), which had a duration but no moment — the reason a load of 82 could sit beside 'absent' with no stated boundary.
